in_marathi.name: Gurupriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Guru's Beloved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurupriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is dear to the Guru, the spiritual guide. The name Gurupriya is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Guru' meaning spiritual guide or teacher, and 'Priya' meaning dear or beloved. This name is often given to a child who is believed to have a strong bond with their guru or teacher.
